newsitem.title: DUBAI: November Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: November Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr 14 pct.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose 14.7 percent in November to 33,291 tonnes from 29,032 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.

Exports rose 12 percent to 15,475 tonnes against the same period a year ago, and imports moved up 17 percent to 17,816 tonnes. The figures include transit goods, but do not include courier and mail items.
Transhipments totalled 6,391 tonnes, a 44 percent increase on November 1995's figure.
Courier and mail volumes dropped a year-on-year two percent to 913 tonnes.
For the eighth month in a row, sea-air freight volumes were lower year-on-year, falling five percent in November to 5,608 tonnes.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
